description: A board of core's class board, which an app script builds, with every id given, so that none is drawn at random. Its block classes are defined outside a package, so their registry ids are their names, and the board's content is core's alone. The UI of the join block ships the schema of its state. R writes that block's by, a vector of length one, as an array, and its all_x as a value, while it writes the state of the letters blocks bare. The stack of one block keeps its blocks an array, by the schema of a JSON board, and show_conditions is an array, by the schema that core ships beside its runtime. The client opens the JSON board and saves it as it is.
